threads.body: [General] Dropping `/tmp/gh-aw/agent/` also drops both `cleanup.patch` and `cleanup.noop`. `finalize.sh` requires one of those files from the downloaded `agent` artifact and records a successful agent run as a failure when neither exists, so module cleanup can no longer retain any agent work. Please explicitly package these two known files from `module-cleanup.md` and regenerate the lockfile.

[General] The regenerated artifact allowlist no longer uploads `/tmp/gh-aw/agent/findings.json`, but the `finalize` job still unconditionally passes `./agent-artifact/agent/findings.json` to `post.py` when the agent succeeds. Every successful `/review` run will therefore fail while posting its review. Please explicitly include the findings file in a permitted artifact from `pr-review.md` and regenerate the lockfile.
